subject: [PATCH v3 6/8] mm/hugetlb: retry the pool walk when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where a hugetlb fault bound to one node can take a pool page from another due to the rebuilding of the zonelist. The patch introduces a retry mechanism in the dequeue_hugetlb_folio_nodemask function, which checks if the zonelist has been rebuilt before using each zone returned by the walk. If the zonelist has changed, the function restarts the walk and resets the node it last tried to ensure that no nodes are skipped. This change is necessary because kprobes can hold the walk across the online process, leading to incorrect behavior.
